Fletcher, saw DIN has expanded across a dozen networks and is launching as an EigenLayer AVS, with a growing roster of infrastructure providers in the ecosystem.

I built a signal play for the DIN partner ecosystem off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
